description: Herbert S. Jayasuriya and Two Others v. H. Sumanapala, Commissioner of Local Government of the Western Province Herbert S. Jayasuriya and Two Others v. H. Sumanapala, Commissioner of Local Government of the Western Province View More before Hon. H.N.J. Perera, J.
parties: Herbert S. Jayasuriya and Two Others v. H. Sumanapala, Commissioner of Local Government of the Western Province Herbert S. Jayasuriya and Two Others v. H. Sumanapala, Commissioner of Local Government of the Western Province View More
keywords: The Petitioners sought to quash a quit notice issued under State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act No. 7 of 1979 and prevent their eviction from the premises in suit occupied by their sports club. Held - Respondent was competent authority to issue notice in terms of Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act No. 12 of 1989. Application dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
